events.title: Mail ballots and early voting begin
events.description: Mail ballots are delivered to the U.S. Postal Service; early voting begins.

events.title: Regular MUSD Board Meeting
events.location: Joshua Tree Elementary School · 4950 Sunburst Ave., Joshua Tree
events.description: Watch for budget, school-boundary, enrollment and receiving-school items. Check the official agenda.

events.title: Voter registration deadline
events.description: Last day for ordinary online registration or postmarking a registration application for the Nov. 3 election. Conditional registration remains available in person afterward.

events.title: MUSD Board study session — date to confirm
events.location: Location and time to be confirmed
events.description: The published 2026 Board calendar lists October 27 for a study session. Earlier reporting mentioned October 22; check the official agenda before attending.

events.title: General Election / MUSD Board election
events.description: Election Day; polls are open 7 AM–8 PM. Three MUSD trustee seats are on the ballot.
